preflight_review: The prepare branch constructs protobuf parameters, response controls and the transported CpModel, but never constructs CpSolver or invokes solve.
Exact parameter text and wire roundtrips retain all explicit settings; runtime package, Python wrapper, native helper and descriptor hashes are checked.
The reused transport validates the native model and compares every exported byte with the expected accepted protobuf.

production_review: Production requires an accepted actual preflight report and owner plus a hash-bound root gate binding the exact source, configuration, preflight, model cold, parameters, limits and one-call policy.
Parameter files are compared by exact bytes across the different preflight and production paths.
There is exactly one solver.solve call site. It is reached only when at least 180 seconds native allowance plus 60 seconds finalization reserve remain within the 300-second owner.
The solver receives 175 seconds, one worker, seed zero, presolve true, probing zero, linearization zero and symmetry zero. Logging settings match the frozen configuration.
Native solve elapsed time above 180 seconds is preserved as UNKNOWN_NATIVE_BUDGET_OVERRUN. There is no retry or alternate call.

The original native response text, primary and every additional integer vector are saved before protobuf parsing or exact arithmetic. Reconstructed protobuf wire is explicitly labeled as reconstructed from native text.
Every returned vector is checked with Python integers against every variable domain and every linear row, with exact row activities retained.
INFEASIBLE remains unproved; a checked returned vector remains an exterior-relaxation witness pending separate cold and the missing original pair-cap/second-component checks.
ownership_review: Initial, supervisor and final owner receipts have distinct immutable paths.
The pinned supervisor starts a new process group, kills its owned group in finally and reaps the child.
Owner acceptance requires zero child exit, successful reaping and group cleanup, matching source/configuration/model size, a terminal report and no owner deadline overrun.
Partial native states, exceptions and hard deadline outcomes remain preserved and unaccepted.
workflow_review: Push trigger is restricted to the dedicated workflow/request paths on the research branch; the first-attempt guard and expected-parent/ref checks prevent unchanged retries.
Permissions are read only and checkout does not persist credentials. Actions are pinned by commit.
The explicit sparse checkout covers the runner/configuration, seven accepted inputs, four helpers, this review, workflow, request and gate.
The gate stage checks request/gate agreement, exact dependency hashes and sizes, zero allowed optimizer calls and the 60/75-second preparation contract.
Python source compilation does not execute imports. The workflow installs the pinned runtime and invokes only the owned prepare mode once.
Always-run export preserves exact small artifact bytes through base64, and the complete CI artifact retains the transported model and all output files.
